step_by_step_reasoning: The visual architecture diagram consists of Web/Mobile client devices and external Game APIs connecting into AWS services. Web/Mobile devices connect to API Gateway, which routes to AWS Lambda. Lambda is also triggered by CloudWatch and Game APIs. Lambda interacts with MongoDB and writes to S3. Data from MongoDB is pushed to S3. S3 then feeds data to EMR for analytics processing and to Redshift for analytics storage.
